statement: Can this technique for directly producing full colorings be used to make progress on the Beck-Fiala [6] conjecture? As a first step, can this approach give an algorithmic form of Banaszczyk’s result [2]? Although our algorithm does not directly produce partial colorings, our analysis involves multiple phases, which are somewhat analogous to partial colorings. Can the analysis be refined to avoid the notion of phases?
